armySpecialRules.name: Chaos Armour
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule add +1 to their armour
saves if they wear light, medium or heavy armour.

armySpecialRules.name: Ensorcelled Weapons
armySpecialRules.description:
Ensorcelled Weapons are hand weapons which use the
following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
Combat +1 Magical Attacks

armySpecialRules.name: Daemonic
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule have the Fear and
Magical Attacks special rules. In addition, models that
are not mounts have a 5+ Ward save which gets
reduced to a 6+ Ward save against Magical Attacks.
In addition, a Daemon can have any of the following in
addition to the rules above:
• Daemon of Khorne: A Daemon of Khorne has the
Hatred (Daemons of Slaanesh), Magic Resistance (1)
and Mighty Blow (1) special rules.
• Daemon of Nurgle: A Daemon of Nurgle has the
Hatred (Daemons of Tzeentch) special rule, and
enemy models in base contact suffer -1 to their
Weapon Skill.
• Daemon of Slaanesh: A Daemon of Slaanesh has
the Hatred (Daemons of Khorne) and Armour
Piercing (1) special rules. Each To Hit roll of 6
generates an additional Attack. These additional
Attacks cannot generate further attacks.
• Daemon of Tzeentch: A Daemon of Tzeentch has
the Hatred (Daemons of Nurgle) special rule and a
6+ Ward save. Wizards with the Daemon of Tzeentch
upgrade can also re-roll channelling results of 1.

armySpecialRules.name: Eye Of The Gods
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule can never refuse a
challenge and, if possible, must always issue one. If
there are several models with this special rule involved
in a combat, the controlling player chooses which will
issue/accept the challenge.
In addition, if a model with this special rule kills an
enemy character or destroys a non-Expendable unit in
either close combat, with spells, or through
charging/pursuing, immediately make a 2D6 roll on the
Eye of the Gods table. If there is more than one
character in the unit at the time of the destruction of the
enemy unit through pursuit, each character gets to
make a separate roll. Once the result of the roll has
been determined, make a note on your army roster -
that model now has that reward for the rest of the
battle.
A model can have several rewards, and it can even
have the same reward multiple times. If, for any
reason, a reward cannot be applied, the result is instead
treated as a 'The Eye Opens' result.
Note that the model itself must cause the last unsaved
Wound on an enemy model to claim the kill. If an
enemy model suffered multiple Wounds
simultaneously, randomise between the sources to
determine which caused the final Wound.

armySpecialRules.name: Marks Of Chaos
armySpecialRules.description:
Many characters and regiments in the Warriors of
Chaos army have, or can purchase, one of the four
Marks of Chaos detailed below. A character with a
Mark of Chaos cannot join a unit that has a different
Mark of Chaos. A character with a Mark of Chaos
cannot join a unit that has already been joined by a
character that has a different Mark of Chaos.
• Mark of Khorne: Models with the Mark of Khorne
have the Frenzy special rule.
• Mark of Nurgle: Models with the Mark of Nurgle
add +1 to their Toughness.
• Mark of Slaanesh: Models with the Mark of
Slaanesh have the Immunity (Psychology) and
Stubborn special rules.
• Mark of Tzeentch: Models with the Mark of
Tzeentch have the Magic Resistance (1) and Ward
save (6+) special rules.

armySpecialRules.name: Will Of Chaos
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule always re-roll failed
Panic tests.

armySpecialRules.name: Eye Of The Gods Table
armySpecialRules.description:
2D6 Result
2 Damned by Chaos: The model is removed from
play as a casualty. If the model is mounted, its
mount is also removed from play.
If you have a spare Chaos Spawn model, you can
place it where the model was. If the model was in
close combat, the Spawn will remain so if
possible. If the model was in a unit before being
turned into a Spawn, place the Spawn within 3" of
the model's last position, at least 1" away from
any unit or impassable terrain. It retains none of
the equipment, upgrades, magic items, Chaos
Mutations & Powers, special rules or spells. If the
model had a Mark of Chaos, it now instead has
the Spawn upgrade of the corresponding god. The
new Spawn does not generate any new Victory
Points.
If you do not have a spare Chaos Spawn model, or
if it cannot be placed on the board according to
the aforementioned restrictions, then no Chaos
Spawn model is placed.
3 Aura of Chaos: The model gains the Ward save
(6+) special rule.
4 Unholy Resilience: The model gains +1
Toughness.
5 Iron Skin: The model gains the Natural Armour
(6+) special rule.
6 Murderous Mutation: The model gains +1
Weapon Skill.
7 The Eye Opens: The model can re-roll one failed
roll To Hit, roll To Wound or saving throw until
the end of his next turn.
8 Unearthly Reflexes: The model gains +1
Initiative.
2D6 Result
9 Dark Fury: The model gains +1 Attack.
10 Slaughterer's Strength: The model gains +1
Strength.
11 Command of the Gods: The model gains +1
Leadership.
12 Dark Apotheosis: The model is replaced with a
Daemon Prince (if you have a spare Daemon
Prince model) where the model was. Any Wounds
lost during the game before becoming a Daemon
Prince are not carried over. If the model is
mounted, its mount is also removed from play. If
the model was in close combat, the Daemon
Prince will remain so if possible. If the model was
in a unit before being turned into a Daemon
Prince, place the Daemon Prince within 3" of the
model's last position, at least 1" away from any
unit or impassable terrain. This Daemon Prince
will retain any Chaos Mutations & Powers, Magic
Items and any other rewards from this table
gained (if it had any). If the model had a Mark of
Chaos, it now instead has the Daemon upgrade of
the corresponding god. Any mundane equipment
is removed. If the model was your Army General
or Battle Standard Bearer, the Daemon Prince
remains so. If the model was a Wizard, the
Daemon Prince retains his Wizard levels and
knows the same spells as the model did before
turning into a Daemon Prince. The new Daemon
Prince does not generate any additional Victory
Points, use the model's original cost.
If you do not have a spare Daemon Prince model,
or if it cannot be placed on the board according to
the aforementioned restrictions, then no Daemon
Prince is placed and the model is removed from
play. No Victory Points are awarded in this case.

magicItems.name: Chaos Daemonsword
magicItems.description:
A model with the Daemonsword adds D3 to their
Strength and has an extra D3 Attacks, to a maximum of
10 (roll separately for these values at the start of each
round). However, every To Hit roll of a 1 made by this
character in close combat is resolved against themself;
the character can never re-roll a To Hit roll of a 1.

magicItems.name: Rending Sword
magicItems.description:
All attacks with the Rending Sword may re-roll failed
To Wound rolls and have the Multiple Wounds (D3)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Hellfire Sword
magicItems.description:
Close combat attacks made with the Hellfire Sword
have the Flaming Attacks and Ignores Armour Saves
special rules. After all close combat blows have been
struck, roll a D6 for every foe slain by the Hellfire
Sword - on the roll of a 6, the slain foe's body
explodes, inflicting an additional D6 Strength 4 hits on
the enemy unit with the Flaming Attacks special rule.
Unsaved Wounds inflicted in this way count towards
the combat result. At the end of each of the wielder's
turns, roll a D6; on the roll of a 1, they suffer one
Wound with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: Vampiric Axe
magicItems.description:
Great weapon. For each unsaved Wound the wielder
inflicts with this weapon, they regain +1 Wound up to
their starting value.

magicItems.name: Aethersword
magicItems.description:
The Aethersword gives the wielder the Ignores Armour
Saves special rule. In addition, no Parry saves from
shields may be taken against it either.

magicItems.name: The Father Of Blades
magicItems.description:
All To Hit rolls of 1 directed against the wielder of the
Father of Blades in close combat instead hit the
attacking model.

magicItems.name: Doombringer Blade
magicItems.description:
After deployment is complete, choose one enemy
Character or Monster. All friendly units gain +1 To
Wound in close combat against the chosen model.

magicItems.name: Soul Cleaver
magicItems.description:
Any model that suffers an unsaved Wound from the
Soul Cleaver must pass a Toughness test or suffer an
additional wound with no saves allowed. This
additional wound does not cause an additional
Toughness test.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Warriors
ms found in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Void Armour
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. Heavy armour. The wearer gains
the Ethereal special rule. However, they may take no
other Magic Items.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Morrslieb
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The Armour of Morrslieb gives the
wearer a 4+ Ward Save against non-Magical Attacks.

magicItems.name: Crimson Armour Of Dargan
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The wearer of the Crimson Armour
gains Immunity (Killing Blow/Multiple Wounds)
against close combat attacks and a Ward save (6+).

magicItems.name: Helm Of The Oppressor
magicItems.description:
This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. All
enemy units within 6" of the wearer of this helmet
suffer -1 to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: Idolatrous Plackart
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The wearer of this armour have a 5+
Ward save which gets reduced to a 6+ Ward save
against Magical Attacks.

magicItems.name: Armour Of The Damned
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. Enemy models must re-roll successful
To Hit rolls in close combat against the wearer of this
armour.

magicItems.name: Null Plate
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. All close combat and missile attacks
targeting the wearer of this armour suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: Bronze Armour Of Zhrakk
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The Bronze Armour of Zhrakk gives the
wearer the Animated Construct special rule (though
they may still march). However, no other model may
use the model's Leadership.

magicItems.name: Skinhidden Plate
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The Skinhidden Plate gives the wearer
the Natural Armour (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Desecrator Gauntlets
magicItems.description:
This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. All
enemy Wizards within 12" of the wearer of these
gauntlets suffer -2 to their casting results. In addition,
the wearer gains +1 To Wound against Wizards in close
combat.

magicItems.name: Helm Of Many Eyes
magicItems.description:
This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. The
wearer gains the Always Strikes First and Stupidity
special rules.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Tortured Souls
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The Armour of Tortured Souls gives the
wearer +1 Toughness against non-Magical Attacks.

magicItems.name: Fused Armour
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The wearer of this armour automatically
passes all Characteristic tests (except Leadership tests).

magicItems.name: Weird Plate
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. All models attempting to strike the
wearer of this armour suffer -1 Attack (to a minimum
of 1).

magicItems.name: Helm Of Eldritch Command
magicItems.description:
Wizard only. This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour
save. Whenever the wearer successfully dispels an
enemy spell (except Summoning or Innate Bound
Spells), they may attempt to cast that spell themselves
(limited by their Wizard level as normal) in their next
Magic phase.

magicItems.name: Shield Of Teeth
magicItems.description:
Shield. If the bearer of this shield makes a successful
Parry save, they immediately get to make an additional
Attack.

magicItems.name: Crown Of Everlasting Conquest
magicItems.description:
The wearer of the Crown of Everlasting Conquest
gains the Inspiring Presence (6) and Regeneration (4+)
special rules.

magicItems.name: Gaze Of The Gods
magicItems.description:
The Gaze of the Gods gives the wearer a 4+ Ward save.
However, if the model flees for any reason, the model
is turned into a Chaos Spawn with the same number of
wounds remaining as the character had, after working
out the Flee move. If you do not have a Spawn model
to replace the character then he simply counts as slain.
For Victory Points purposes, the character is not
counted as slain or below half Wounds unless the
Spawn he has turned into is slain or is below half
Wounds.

magicItems.name: The Book Of Secrets
magicItems.description:
The Book of Secrets allows the Wizard to choose an
additional spell from each of the Lores of Fire, Shadow
and Death, following the normal rules for choosing
spells. This does not give them any additional access to
any Signature spells. In addition, they get +1 to channel
power dice, but do not channel any dispel dice. If the
bearer ever miscasts, roll 2D6 on the Miscast table and
choose the highest result.

magicItems.name: Infernal Puppet
magicItems.description:
Whenever any Wizard on the battlefield miscasts while
casting a spell, the bearer of the Infernal Puppet may
choose to modify any rolls on the Miscast table made
by that Wizard by up to D3 each time.

magicItems.name: Blasphemous Amulet
magicItems.description:
At the start of every close combat phase, all enemy
models in base contact with the bearer of the
Blasphemous Amulet must pass a Toughness test or
suffer one Wound which Ignores Armour Saves. This
has no effect against Animated Constructs.

magicItems.name: Rod Of Torment
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell, Power Level 5. The Rod of Torment
contains a magic missile with a range of 18" and
causes 2D6 Strength 3 hits.

magicItems.name: Faithless Charm
magicItems.description:
The Faithless Charm gives the bearer the Always Strike
First and Killing Blow special rules. However, if they
fail any Leadership test, they lose Always Strike First
and gain Frenzy and Always Strikes Last instead. The
bearer cannot lose their Frenzy.

magicItems.name: Mark Of The All-Favoured
magicItems.description:
At the start of each of your turns, the bearer of this item
can choose one Mark of Chaos, whose effects lasts
until the start of your next turn. This has no effect on a
model that already has a Mark of Chaos.

magicItems.name: Realmwarper'S Twist-Rune
magicItems.description:
At the start of any of your turns, choose one terrain
feature within 12" of the bearer. All enemy models
within 1" of that terrain feature must take a Dangerous
Terrain test, which fails on a 1-2.

magicItems.name: Star Of Chaos
magicItems.description:
Ungorr may re-roll one failed To Hit, To Wound,
Armour or Ward Save roll in each phase.

magicItems.name: Chalice Of Chaos
magicItems.description:
One use only. The bearer of the Chalice of Chaos may
drink from it at the start of any phase. If he chooses to
do so, roll a D6 and consult the table below.
D6 Result:
1 Unworthy Fool: The imbiber immediately
suffers a Wound, with no saves of any kind
allowed.
2 Inhuman Speed: The imbiber gains the
Always Strikes First special rule until the end
of the turn.
3 Regenerating Flesh: The imbiber gains the
Regeneration (4+) special rule until the end of
the turn.
4 Dark Fortune: The imbiber gains the Ward
save (5+) special rule until the end of the turn.
5 Daemonic Strength: The imbiber gains the
Killing Blow special rule until the end of the
turn.
6 Final Transformation: If the imbiber is
already a Daemon Prince, he instead treats this
result as Unworthy Fool. Otherwise, he must
immediately take a Leadership test. If passed,
he is gifted with Daemonhood, as described on
the Eye of the Gods table. If failed, he is gifted
with Spawndom, as described on the same
table.

magicItems.name: Pendant Of Damnation
magicItems.description:
Infantry or Cavalry only. The bearer of this item gains
+1 Attack for every Wound they suffer during the
game. If their lost Wounds are restored, this bonus is
lost.

magicItems.name: Favour Of The Gods
magicItems.description:
After rolling on the Eye of the Gods table the bearer
may add or subtract one from his roll. This may not
affect a result of 2 or 12.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Gods
magicItems.description:
The bearer of the Banner of the Gods causes Terror,
and any unit joined by them gains the Unbreakable
special rule.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Demagogue
magicItems.description:
All friendly units within 12" of this standard gain +1
Leadership.

magicItems.name: Doom Totem
magicItems.description:
All enemy units with Line of Sight to the Doom Totem
suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership. This standard
has no effect on models with Immunity (Psychology).

magicItems.name: Blasphemous Icon
magicItems.description:
Enemy units in base contact with this standard must
roll an additional dice when taking Leadership tests
and discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Wrath
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell, power level 4. The Banner of Wrath
contains a magic missile with a range of 24". If cast, it
causes D6 Strength 4 hits with the Lightning Attacks
special rule.
KHORNE MAGIC ITEMS
This section contains the rules for some of the most iconic
of Khorne. These may be used in addition to the magic ite
be chosen by models with the Daemon of Khorne or Mar

magicItems.name: Bane Spear
magicItems.description:
Spear/light lance. This weapon gives +1 Strength for
each enemy model in base contact with the wielder.

magicItems.name: Berserker Sword
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. The Berserker Sword gives the
wielder +1 Attack for every enemy model in base
contact. In a challenge, it only confers +1 Attack.

magicItems.name: Blade Of Endless Bloodshed
magicItems.description:
Whenever the wielder of this weapon causes an
unsaved Wound, they may make an additional Attack
(up to a maximum of +3). These attacks can generate
additional Attacks.

magicItems.name: Blade Of Blood
magicItems.description:
For every unsaved Wound caused by the Blade of
Blood, the wielder may take a Strength test. If passed,
the wielder regains 1 Wound previously lost during the
game. However, if the test is failed, the wielder loses 1
Wound with no saves allowed instead.

magicItems.name: Axe Of Khorne
magicItems.description:
This axe confers +1 Strength and the Killing Blow
special rule upon the bearer.

magicItems.name: Gorecleaver
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon gains the Armour Piercing
(1) and Multiple Wounds (2) special rules.

magicItems.name: Spelleater Shield
magicItems.description:
Shield. The Spelleater Shield gives the bearer Magic
Resistance (2). In addition, roll a D6 each time a spell
is cast at the bearer of the Spelleater Shield and is
dispelled. On the roll of a 4+, the spell is destroyed and
the enemy Wizard may not cast it for the rest of the
battle.

magicItems.name: The Blood-Forged Armour
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The wearer of this item cannot have
their armour reduced below 4+.

magicItems.name: The Skull-Helm Of Khorne
magicItems.description:
This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. All
enemy units within 6" of the wearer must re-roll
successful Break tests.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Warriors
ems found in the Warhammer rulebook. They may only
rk of Khorne special rules.

magicItems.name: Bloodskull Pendant
magicItems.description:
Instead of making his normal attacks for that round, the
bearer of the Bloodskull Pendant may choose to inflict
an automatic Strength 8 Hit with the Killing Blow
special rule on every enemy model in base contact.

magicItems.name: The Brazen Rune
magicItems.description:
The wearer of this item gains a 2+ Ward save against
spells.

magicItems.name: Mark Of The Destroyer
magicItems.description:
The wielder doubles their amount of Attacks (to a
maximum of 10). However, if the wearer fails to kill at
least one model each close combat phase in which they
are part of, treat this as having rolled the Damned by
Chaos result on the Eye of the Gods chart.

magicItems.name: Blood Rune
magicItems.description:
All wounds caused in close combat by the bearer of
this item counts as double for the purpose of combat
resolution, up to a maximum of +3.

magicItems.name: Talisman Of Burning Blood
magicItems.description:
The wearer of this item and any unit they are with
gains the Vanguard special rule.

magicItems.name: The Black Tongue
magicItems.description:
One use only. The Black Tongue can be used whenever
an enemy Wizard fails to cast a spell. When used, the
spell counts as having been Miscast. The model
bearing the Black Tongue then suffers a wound with no
saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Blood
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard may re-roll failed
charge distances.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Rage
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying the Banner of Rage can never lose
their Frenzy. In addition, it may re-roll failed Break
Tests.
NURGLE MAGIC ITEMS
This section contains the rules for some of the most iconic
of Nurgle. These may be used in addition to the magic ite
be chosen by models with the Daemon of Nurgle or Mark

magicItems.name: Rustfang
magicItems.description:
Any enemy unit in base contact with the wielder of this
weapon suffer a -1 penalty to their armour saves.

magicItems.name: Filth Mace
magicItems.description:
Close combat attacks made with the Filth Mace have
the Poisoned Attacks special rule. Once the wielder has
killed an enemy model in close combat, they
immediately gain the Terror special rule and, from the
start of the next Close Combat phase (friend or foe), all
subsequent Attacks made with the Filth Mace have the
Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: Glaive Of Putrefaction
magicItems.description:
Polearm. Every unsaved Wound caused by the Glaive
of Putrefaction against Characters, Monstrous
Creatures or Monsters makes the victim suffer -1 to
their Strength and Toughness for the remainder of the
game.

magicItems.name: Sublucus' Stenchplate
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. At the start of each round of close
combat, all enemy models in base contact with the
bearer must pass a Toughness test or suffer a Wound
which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: The Splithorn Helm
magicItems.description:
This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. Enemy
models suffer -1 To Wound against this wearer in close
combat and with missile attacks.

magicItems.name: The Shield Of Growths
magicItems.description:
Shield. The bearer of this shield may re-roll failed
armour saves if the Strength of the attack is equal to or
higher than the bearer's modified armour save (for
example, if the bearer is Hit by a Strength 4 Attack and
their modified armour save is 4+).

magicItems.name: Spore Censer
magicItems.description:
All missile attacks targeting the wearer or the unit they
are with suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: The Foetid Shroud
magicItems.description:
All close combat attacks targeting the wearer of this
item suffer -1 To Hit.

k of Nurgle special rules.

magicItems.name: Rod Of Corruption
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell, Power Level 3. The Rod of Corruption
contains a direct damage spell with a range of 24".
The target unit suffers D6 Strength 2 Hits with the
Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: Flesh Pealer
magicItems.description:
At the start of your Magic phase, all enemy units
within 6" of the bearer of this item suffer D6 Strength 3
Hits which Ignores Armour saves.

magicItems.name: The Bileheart
magicItems.description:
Every time the bearer of this item suffers an unsaved
Wound, the model that struck the blow suffer a
Strength 5 Hit which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: The Eye Of Nurgle
magicItems.description:
This item can be used at the start of any round of close
combat. Roll 2D6, if the result is 7, then one model in
base contact of your choosing suffers D3 Wounds
which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: The Carrion Dirge
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item may be used at the start of any
of your turns. Once used, all enemy units within 12"
suffer -2 to their Leadership for the duration of the
turn.

magicItems.name: The Fecund Flask
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item can be used at the start of any
of your turns. Roll a D6, on a 2+, the model
immediately recovers all Wounds (ignoring any
additional Wounds from mounts) up to their starting
value. On the roll of a 1, treat this as the model having
rolled the Damned by Chaos result on the Eye of the
Gods chart.

magicItems.name: Festering Shroud
magicItems.description:
All units in base contact with the unit carrying the
Festering Shroud must re-roll successful rolls To
Wound. This standard has no effect on models with the
Mark of Nurgle or Animated Constructs.

magicItems.name: Eroding Icon
magicItems.description:
Mark of Nurgle only. All enemy units in base contact
with this standard counts the armour save modifier
from their Strength or Armour Piercing attacks as being
1 point worse than normal.

This section contains the rules for some of the most iconic
of Slaanesh. These may be used in addition to the magic i

magicItems.name: Gilellion'S Soulnetter
magicItems.description:
This weapon gives the wielder +2 Attacks. In addition,
all enemy units in base contact that fail their break test
roll one D6 less than normal for their flee distance.

magicItems.name: Slaanesh'S Blade
magicItems.description:
All attacks with this weapon have the Ignores Armour
Saves special rule. In addition, the wielder gains the
Parry (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Whip Of Pleasure
magicItems.description:
Mark of Slaanesh only. The Whip of Pleasure gives the
wielder +1 Attack. In addition, the wielder gains the
Always Strikes First special rule in the first round of
close combat.

magicItems.name: Whip Of Subversion
magicItems.description:
Mark of Slaanesh only. If an enemy Character,
Monstrous Creature or Monster takes an unsaved
wound from the Whip of Subversion and that model
has not yet made its attacks for that round, then you
may force it to allocate its attacks upon itself or other
models from its own side.

magicItems.name: Blade Of Ecstasy
magicItems.description:
Mark of Slaanesh only. Each time the Blade of Ecstasy
inflicts an unsaved wound on a model, that model must
pass a Strength test or be removed from the game.

magicItems.name: Breathtaker
magicItems.description:
Each time an enemy Character, Monstrous Creature or
Monster is Hit by this weapon, they suffer -1 Attack for
the duration of this round of close combat.

magicItems.name: Jewel Of Denial
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item gains a 5+ Ward save. In
addition, each time they make a successful Ward save
in close combat, they gain +1 combat resolution bonus.

magicItems.name: The Beguiling Gem
magicItems.description:
At the start of each round of close combat, all enemy
models in base contact with the wielder must pass a
Psychology test or lose 1 Attack.

magicItems.name: Cameo Of The Dark Prince
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item and any unit they are with gain
the Cold-blooded special rule.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Warriors

or Mark of Slaanesh special rules.

magicItems.name: Sceptre Of Domination
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell, Power Level 3. The Sceptre of
Domination contains the Pavane of Slaanesh spell from
the Lore of Slaanesh.

magicItems.name: Bindings Of Slaanesh
magicItems.description:
Enemies cannot refuse challenges issued by the wearer
of the Bindings of Slaanesh. In addition, they are
subject to the Always Strikes Last special rule in
challenges (including mounts).

magicItems.name: Ring Of Sensation
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item gains +1 Attack for every
enemy spell that is successfully cast within 12". The
effect lasts until the start of the enemy's next Magic
phase.

magicItems.name: The Rod Of Misrule
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item gains the Inspiring Presence (6)
and Stupidity special rules.

magicItems.name: The Crown Of Dark Secrets
magicItems.description:
After deployment, choose one enemy Character. The
bearer of this item may re-roll failed To Hit rolls
against that model for the duration of the game.

magicItems.name: Pendant Of Slaanesh
magicItems.description:
No other character may join the same unit as the bearer
and he cannot join units that already contain a
character. For each unsaved Wound the bearer suffers,
he gains +1 Attack for the rest of the battle.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Screaming Flesh
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Devastating
Charge special rule.

magicItems.name: Rapturous Standard
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying the Rapturous Standard gains the
Unbreakable special rule.

magicItems.name: Icon Of Infinite Excess
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard and any enemy unit in
base contact with them gain +1 To Hit in close combat.
TZEENTCH MAGIC ITEMS
This section contains the rules for some of the most iconic
of Tzeentch. These may be used in addition to the magic i
only be chosen by models with the Daemon of Tzeentch o

magicItems.name: Secret-Eater
magicItems.description:
Each time the wielder of this weapon rolls a 6 To Hit,
they may re-roll one failed To Hit, To Wound, armour
or Ward save this round.

magicItems.name: Ambition'S End
magicItems.description:
This weapon has Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule
against Characters. In addition, each time they cause an
unsaved Wound against a Wizard, that model loses a
Wizard level.

magicItems.name: Wicked Shard
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon can re-roll all failed rolls
To Wound.

magicItems.name: Paradoxical Shield
magicItems.description:
Shield. This shield gives the bearer the Parry (5+)
special rule even while mount. However, the bearer
must re-roll successful armour saves.

magicItems.name: Golden Eye Of Tzeentch
magicItems.description:
The bearer gains a 3+ Ward save against all missile
attacks.

magicItems.name: Crystal Pendant
magicItems.description:
Infantry or Cavalry only. The bearer of this item may
re-roll failed Ward saves.

magicItems.name: Staff Of Change
magicItems.description:
The bearer can re-roll any dice of their choice when
casting or dispelling. However, if the bearer casts a
spell with Ultimate Power using the staff's re-roll
ability, the staff will cease working for the rest of the
battle.

magicItems.name: Souldraught
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item may be used at the start of any
Magic phase. For the duration of this Magic phase, roll
an additional D6 when casting or dispelling spells and
discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: Blood Of Tzeentch
magicItems.description:
The bearer of the Blood of Tzeentch may re-roll one
casting dice per turn, provided it was not originally a
roll of a 1.

magicItems.name: Mirror Of Knowledge
magicItems.description:
The bearer can pick any enemy unit within 24" at the
beginning of each of his Magic phases. The opponent
must reveal everything that is not apparent about the
unit, such as Magic Items and Hidden units.

magicItems.name: Nexus Staff
magicItems.description:
Wizard only. For each unsaved Wound caused by the
wielder in close combat, they gain a +1 casting bonus
in their next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: Warp Mirror
magicItems.description:
All bonuses that are not from Magic Items or spells
(such as Charge Bonus, Mighty Blow, Devastating
Charge, Impact Hits etc.) that occur in the first round of
close combat are given to the opposite side for both the
bearer of this item and any unit they are with as well as
any enemy unit in base contact with the bearer.

magicItems.name: Fractured Clasp
magicItems.description:
All enemy units in base contact with the bearer of this
item suffer -1 to their Weapon Skill and Leadership.

magicItems.name: Timeslip Pendant
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item may be used after the wearer
has made all their normal close combat attacks. When
used, they may fight an additional time.

magicItems.name: Daemonheart
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item may be used at the start of any
round of close combat. Once used, the wielder gains +2
Strength and +2 Attacks. Roll a D6 after resolving all
attacks; on the roll of 1, the bearer suffer a Wound
which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: Blasted Standard
magicItems.description:
Each time the unit carrying the Blasted Standard
suffers a hit from a shooting attack, roll a D6
immediately before rolling To Wound. On the roll of
2+, the Strength of that hit is halved. However, if the
result is a 1, the Strength of that hit is instead doubled.
Attacks that do not roll To Wound, or that wound
automatically, are not affected by the Blasted Standard.

magicItems.name: Glamour Fetish
magicItems.description:
All enemy units within 12" of the bearer of this
standard suffer -1 Leadership when taking Break tests.

loresOfMagic.name: Chaos
loresOfMagic.attribute:
Whenever a Wizard successfully cast a spell from the
Lore of Chaos, the Wizard's Weapon Skill, Toughness
and Leadership are increased by 1 until the start of their
next Magic phase.

mutations_and_powers.name: Mantle Of Chaos
mutations_and_powers.description:
Any missile attacks targeting the character or the unit
they are with have their Strength value halved,
rounding up. This has no effect against Magical
Attacks.

mutations_and_powers.name: Diabolic Splendour
mutations_and_powers.description:
Any successful Leadership tests taken by an enemy
unit in base contact with the character must be re-
rolled. This mutation cannot be combined with
Fearsome Aura.

mutations_and_powers.name: Fearsome Aura
mutations_and_powers.description:
All enemy units within 6" of this character suffer -1 to
their Leadership.

mutations_and_powers.name: Terrifying Appearance
mutations_and_powers.description: The character has the Terror special rule.

mutations_and_powers.name: Wings
mutations_and_powers.description:
Infantry only. The character has the Fly (10) special
rule.

mutations_and_powers.name: Flaming Breath
mutations_and_powers.description:
The character has a Strength 3 Breath Weapon that has
the Flaming Attacks special rule.

mutations_and_powers.name: Bestial Visage
mutations_and_powers.description: The character has the Fear special rule.

mutations_and_powers.name: Extra Arm
mutations_and_powers.description:
The character may wield both a weapon that Requires
Two Hands and a shield at the same time, benefitting
from both pieces of equipment. This mutation cannot
be combined with Tentacle.

mutations_and_powers.name: Soul Feeder
mutations_and_powers.description:
Roll a D6 for every unsaved Wound the character
inflicts on an enemy unit in close combat. For each
result of a 6 rolled, they immediately regain a single
lost Wound.

mutations_and_powers.name: Chaos Familiar
mutations_and_powers.description:
Wizard only. The character knows one more spell than
normal for their level.
your characters. Each can only be chosen once per army

mutations_and_powers.name: Distendable Maw
mutations_and_powers.description:
Instead of making his usual attacks, the character can
choose to make a special attack against a single
Infantry model. If the attack hits, the enemy model
must pass an Initiative test. If this test is failed, the
victim suffers D3 Wounds with no saves allowed.

mutations_and_powers.name: Poisonous Slime
mutations_and_powers.description:
The character has the Poisoned Attacks and Immunity
(Poisoned Attacks) special rules.

mutations_and_powers.name: Scaled Skin
mutations_and_powers.description: The character has the Natural Armour (6+) special rule.

mutations_and_powers.name: Acid Ichor
mutations_and_powers.description:
Whenever this character suffers an unsaved Wound in
close combat, the model that inflicted that Hit suffers a
Strength 4 hit, which count towards the combat result.

mutations_and_powers.name: Burning Body
mutations_and_powers.description:
The character has the Flaming Attacks and Immunity
(Flaming Attacks) special rules.

mutations_and_powers.name: Cloven Hooves
mutations_and_powers.description:
Model on foot only. The Champion gains +1
Movement. This mutation cannot be combined with
Serpent Body.

mutations_and_powers.name: Horns
mutations_and_powers.description:
Model on foot only. The character gets the Impact Hits
(1) special rule.

mutations_and_powers.name: Tentacle
mutations_and_powers.description:
The character may grapple with a single opponent in
base contact, forcing them to lose one Attack.
However, the character is not allowed to use a shield or
any weapon that Requires Two Hands.

mutations_and_powers.name: Unholy Strike
mutations_and_powers.description:
Instead of attacking normally, the character can choose
to make a single special Attack. If they do so, and the
Attack hits, the hit is resolved at double the character's
Strength and has the Multiple Wounds (D3) special
rule.
POWERS OF KHORNE
The following powers may only be taken by models
with the Mark of Khorne or Daemon of Khorne.

mutations_and_powers.name: Bloodcurdling Roar
mutations_and_powers.description:
At the start of the first round of close combat, all
enemy units in base contact suffer D6 Strength 2 hits
which Ignores Armour saves.

mutations_and_powers.name: Blood Fever
mutations_and_powers.description:
The model will never lose their Frenzy for any reason.
In addition, any unit, friend or foe, that is in base
contact with them at the start of their Movement phase
becomes subject to Frenzy for the rest of that turn. If
they already have the Frenzy special rule, they instead
gain +1 Attack, but will have to re-roll any successful
Berserk Rage roll.

mutations_and_powers.name: Fury Of The Blood God
mutations_and_powers.description:
The model gains the Hatred special rule. Any Wizard
within 12" of the character suffer -D3 to each of their
casting rolls.

mutations_and_powers.name: Deafening Bellow
mutations_and_powers.description:
On the turn that the character charges, all enemy units
in base contact suffer -1 To Hit in close combat.
POWERS OF NURGLE
The following powers may only be taken by models
with the Mark of Nurgle or Daemon of Nurgle.

mutations_and_powers.name: Stream Of Corruption
mutations_and_powers.description:
The character gains a Breath Weapon. All models Hit
must pass a Toughness test or suffer a Wound with the
Ignores Armour saves special rule.

mutations_and_powers.name: Massive Bulk
mutations_and_powers.description: The character gains +1 Wound.

mutations_and_powers.name: Nurgling Infestation
mutations_and_powers.description:
Each model that attacks the character in close combat
suffer an automatic Strength 3 hit after the attacker's
hits have been worked out. This hit occurs even if the
character with the Nurgling Infestation is slain and any
wounds caused count towards combat resolution.

mutations_and_powers.name: Secondary Jaws
mutations_and_powers.description:
The character gains a special attack at Strength 2 with
the Always Strikes First and Ignores Armour Saves
special rules.

mutations_and_powers.name: Nurgle'S Rot
mutations_and_powers.description:
At the start of every close combat phase, every enemy
model in base contact with the character suffers a
single Strength 1 hit with the Ignores Armour Saves
special rule.
POWERS OF SLAANESH
The following powers may only be taken by models
with the Mark of Slaanesh or Daemon of Slaanesh.

mutations_and_powers.name: Hellshriek
mutations_and_powers.description:
One use only. The character can use this ability at the
start of any Magic phase, immediately after rolling for
the Winds of Magic. All enemy Wizards within 18"
must immediately roll 2D6 on the Miscast table.

mutations_and_powers.name: Word Of Agony
mutations_and_powers.description:
Once per game, at the beginning of the Close Combat
phase (before challenges are issued), the bearer of the
Word of Agony can choose a model in base contact.
That model takes D6 Strength 4 hits which Ignores
Armour saves.

mutations_and_powers.name: Serpent Body
mutations_and_powers.description:
Model on foot only. The Champion gains +2
Movement, +1 Initiative and the Swiftstride special
rule. This mutation cannot be combined with Cloven
Hooves.

mutations_and_powers.name: Soporific Musk
mutations_and_powers.description:
When a unit flees from a character with this gift or the
unit they are with, the fleeing unit rolls an extra D6 and
discards the highest dice roll.

mutations_and_powers.name: Allure Of Slaanesh
mutations_and_powers.description:
Any opponent wishing to strike the character in close
combat must first pass a Psychology test before rolling
To Hit. If the test is failed, that model cannot make any
close combat attacks that phase. This does not affect
Attacks that do not roll To Hit.
POWERS OF TZEENTCH
The following powers may only be taken by models
with the Mark of Tzeentch or Daemon of Tzeentch.

mutations_and_powers.name: Tendrils Of Tzeentch
mutations_and_powers.description:
Wizards only. The character may re-roll a single power
or dispel dice per player turn. This may potentially
prevent a Miscast.

mutations_and_powers.name: Protean Form
mutations_and_powers.description: The Champion has the Regeneration (5+) special rule.

mutations_and_powers.name: Conjoined Homunculus
mutations_and_powers.description:
Wizard only. Once per turn, the character may choose
to add +D3 to his casting result after attempting to cast
a spell. This extra dice cannot cause a Miscast or count
towards Ultimate Power.

mutations_and_powers.name: Third Eye Of Tzeentch
mutations_and_powers.description:
The character re-rolls Ward save results of 1.

Lore of Chaos, the Wizard's Weapon Skill, Toughness
and Leadership are increased by 1 until the start of their
next Magic phase.

The Summoning is a magic missile with a range of 18"
that causes 2D6 Strength 3 hits with the Armour
Piercing (1) special rule.
DAEMONIC FAMILIARS
Level 1 Cast on 5+
Daemonic Familiars is a hex spell that targets one unit
in base contact with the Wizard. The target suffer 2D6
Strength 2 hits with the Ignores Armour saves special
rule.
